title: Buddy back from the army playing piano
summary: Buddy returned from Kansas City service in his late teens playing impressively.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: So he was already a pretty good piano player in his mid-teens.
When he came back from the army, I remember when he came back from the army, that fella was playing that piano.
How old was he when he came back?
Now he must have been 19, 18 or 19.
So did you guys pick up with him right away?

Pretty much. I was amazed when he came back from the army playing the piano the way he was. Because he had time to come in. He had come home on a little furlough, because he was stationed down in...He didn't go overseas or anything. He was stationed in Kansas City. He'd come home, like for a weekend or something. And every time he'd come it sounded like, when I'd hear him play the piano...Because piano was his thing. He'd go right to the piano.
